snippet.title: Patchkins Party | Gameplay Trailer | Gamflix
snippet.description:
Patchkins is a multiplayer racing game for 2 to 6 players where you build the course as you play. Each round, players draw and place objects like Platforms, Obstacles, and Specials, then race to the finish without dying.

Minimum:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Win 10
Processor: İntel i3 7100
Memory: 2048 MB RAM
Graphics: 128 MB
Storage: 1300 MB available space

Recommended:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Win 11
Processor: i5 12400f
Memory: 2048 MB RAM
Graphics: 1050 ti
Storage: 2000 MB available space
